correctness.rationale: Multiset wreath-product decomposition gives necessary and sufficient characterization of group orders 1 and 2; the two disjoint C2 mechanisms yield polynomial recurrence. A standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies all specified finite carriers and labelled orbit counts; finite checks are not the general proof.

value.rationale: Nested equivalence structures are a naturally motivated finite-model class. The classification distinguishes rigid from exactly-one-involution objects at a sharp, gap-free size boundary, yielding a natural finite symmetry threshold and complete enumerative profiles not implied by counting all nested partitions. The closed capacities, extrema and lower-symmetry polynomial are meaningful even without a downstream complexity theorem.
